title: MiniMax H3 Max 3D to Video
description: Transform Blender renders and 3D previs into photorealistic video. H3 Max uses the source clip to guide scene layout, camera movement, and timing, with optional image references for appearance.

pricing.text: For every second of video you generate you will be charged $0.05 at 480p, $0.08 at 768p or $0.16 at 1080p (minimum 5 seconds), plus reference token usage for your input video and images, the same as H3 Max Reference to Video. If you don't provide reference images, up to max_generated_reference_images (default 2) are generated automatically at about $0.02–$0.04 each. For example, a 5 second 16:9 video at 768p with your own reference images costs about $0.96.

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: Blender video, up to 15 seconds and 32 shots, at a public HTTPS URL.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional clarification of what your proxies represent or how they move, for example: 'The moving block represents a running person.' Camera, trajectories, timing and object count remain defined by the video. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: reference_image
inputs.tooltip: Optional environment, subject, interior or detail references. When supplied, uses these images directly without visual planning or generating new images; Scene Intent is optional. Without references, automatically creates appearance references within your new-image limit. Camera and movement always come from the video. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is numb

inputs.name: max_generated_reference_images
inputs.tooltip: Maximum NEW images to generate when no reference images are supplied. Ignored when reference images are supplied. Uses fewer when enough views are covered. Uncovered shots stay in the video.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: Output quality. Duration is taken automatically from the video.
